text:
Items: one slice of multigrain toast, about 100 kcal (no visible butter). Two fried eggs, about 180 kcal. A quarter avocado, about 60 kcal. A lemon wedge, about 5 kcal. A medium banana, about 105 kcal. A mug of latte or coffee with milk, about 300 ml, roughly 120 kcal.

Served total: about 570 kcal. I'm assuming no leftovers, apart from the lemon wedge and banana peel, which aren't counted as food energy.

Protein: toast 4 g, eggs 12 g, avocado 1 g, banana 1.3 g, milk 7 g, for about 25 g.

Carbs: toast 18 g, banana 27 g, milk 10 g, avocado 3 g, for about 58 g.

Fat: eggs 14 g, avocado 5 g, milk 5 g, toast 1.5 g, for about 25 g.
